name: Shadow · Knight style A (Assassin)
description: Kael as a hooded human assassin in the plumed Knight’s style: near-black purple leathers under an indigo cowl whose peak leans back and whose back drapes onto his shoulders, a plum scarf wound round his throat and up over his nose and mouth as a mask, and one glowing violet eye under the brim. The scarf’s two long tattered tails trail behind him as the Knight’s plume and cape do, rippling in his breathing idle and streaming back on the walk, with short split coat tails flapping below them. He carries twin daggers with 1 px bright edges and violet gem pommels: the near one low and forward, point up, the far one reversed behind his hip. No black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material) and hue-shifted ramps: blue-black shadows, cool lavender lights. His attack crouches and draws both blades back, coils with one blade behind his head, whips both arms forward over his head (a violet arc), then throws: the daggers fly apart point first, up and down, at the heads of two sharp pale-violet streaks that cross in an X before him; he spins round through two violet rings and lands back in his stance with fresh blades and a glint. The eye, the pommel gems, the streaks and the rings glow.
